site.title: Face and Body Laser — Dr. Domenico Campa
site.meta_description: Pigmentation, capillaries, scars, acne and unwanted hair: laser treatments with Dr. Domenico Campa. Personalised assessment and a tailored protocol.

sections.subtitle: Pigmentation, capillaries, scars, redness or unwanted hair are not all approached in the same way. The right laser depends on the skin type, on how deep the concern lies and on the time of year. That is why every path starts with a personalised assessment, to identify the technology and the protocol best suited to the characteristics of your skin.
sections.mission_label_text: TREATING THE SKIN STARTING FROM THE DIAGNOSIS, NOT FROM THE MACHINE
sections.cta_secondary_hint: Assessment at the clinic, with skin analysis and a plan of sessions.

items.name: Grazia Pisani
items.text: I had a corrective filler with Dr. Campa — it was my first time with him. He and his staff are very sweet and kind, and they put you at ease from the very first moment. A natural, elegant result.

items.name: Sara Esposito
items.text: I chose Dr. Campa for a lip filler and I could not be happier with my choice. From the very first visit I felt listened to and carefully looked after. A natural, harmonious result.

items.name: Valentina De Liso
items.text: Dr. Campa turned a simple injection into a surprisingly special moment: precise, gentle, and with an aesthetic sense that makes you feel at ease right away.

items.name: Claudia Leonardi
items.text_strong: My first experience with Dr. Campa was extremely positive!
items.text: A highly professional doctor and, above all, a wonderful person. The staff were incredibly kind. I am truly happy with the result — I warmly recommend him.

items.name: Bruna Tarantino
items.text_strong: Dr. Domenico Campa: a name you can trust.
items.text: Professionalism, precision and humanity are just some of the qualities that set him apart. The clinic is always welcoming and cared for in every detail.

items.name: Lucrezia Stacchini
items.text_strong: It is impossible to describe the doctor and his staff in one word.
items.text: All I can say is that since I met them, they are the only ones I trust. A team attentive to every detail, and a clinical journey cared for at every step.

items.name: Felicya Salcino
items.text_strong: In my opinion he is simply the best.
items.text: As well as being highly professional he is also great fun and puts you at ease straight away. The staff are kind and welcoming — I recommend him without hesitation.

items.name: Federica Raimo
items.text: Today I can smile at life with gratitude and serenity, and it is thanks to Dr. Campa. There truly are no words to describe his extraordinary professionalism and humanity.

items.name: Nunzia Landolfo
items.text: It was my first visit and, after a past experience that had not gone well, I had quite a few doubts. Dr. Campa and his staff immediately put me at ease. An excellent result.

sections.subtitle: Lasers and technologies for skin quality: here you can see which concerns are treated and how. The right treatment is chosen during the consultation, according to skin type and area.
sections.footer_note: Every treatment is preceded by a clinical assessment. The number of sessions and recovery times are indicative and vary according to skin type, the area treated and individual response. Actinic keratoses require dermatological medical assessment.

categories.name: Pigmentation and discolouration
categories.description: Deposits of pigment caused by the sun, by age or by hormonal factors. The laser breaks up the pigment, which is then cleared by the body. Melasma calls for a cautious approach and maintenance over time.

treatments.name: Sun spots (lentigines) on the face and body

categories.name: Redness and capillaries
categories.description: Small dilated vessels and persistent redness. The vascular laser acts on the haemoglobin and closes the vessel, which is then reabsorbed, without affecting the surrounding skin.

treatments.name: Capillaries on the body and legs

categories.name: Acne, scars and texture
categories.description: Active lesions, marks left by acne and irregularities of the skin surface. The work is on remodelling the collagen, to improve relief, colour and firmness.

categories.name: Hair removal and tattoos
categories.description: Progressive reduction of hair regrowth and removal of pigment. Several sessions spaced over time are needed, because the work is on follicles and pigments in their active phase.

categories.name: Regenerative medicine
categories.description: Treatments that do not add volume but stimulate the skin to produce its own collagen, using growth factors from the patient themselves. They are used on their own or alongside the laser.

categories.name: Face and body technologies
categories.description: Non-invasive technologies, other than lasers, that act on tone, firmness and remodelling. No needles and no recovery time.

sections.subtitle: Every skin starts from a different point. The assessment is there to understand which technology is indicated, how many sessions are needed and at what time of year it is best to start.
